utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I saw a gray van with a dented side panel turn onto Maple Street — could be the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I hope so! We'd love to have them on board—did you get a look at the driver?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, I didn't see the driver—just the van pulling around the corner.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, I've been hearing about this repair drive from a few people—sounds like it's this Saturday, right? I might haul over my old mower if I can get it running.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Nell, you're right—it's this Saturday down at the community center! Your mower would be a great help; Tess is bringing tools and Cleo's got lumber ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Well, that's good to know—I'll give my mower a try and see if I can get it sputtering over there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The repair drive is this Saturday! We need spare parts and tools to fix broken stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I didn't realize it was this weekend. What kind of tools are you looking for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly hand tools like screwdrivers, wrenches, and pliers — but any spare screws, hinges, or small appliance parts would be a huge help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... what's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not entirely sure either — I've been trying to piece it together. What have you heard about it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think someone mentioned it's about collecting parts for repairs, but I'm fuzzy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Did you see anyone get out of that van, Noah? I just want to make sure it's the repair crew and not some random vehicle.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Van? Oh, the repair drive—wait, is that today? I thought we were still figuring out the date.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No, I think it's still this weekend—they mentioned Saturday morning. But that van Opal saw just now might be early.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I've got my toolbox ready and a few spare hammers if anyone forgot theirs. Should be a good turn-out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring some sandpaper and paint brushes. Might not be there all day, but I'll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That'd be a real help, Uli. Every bit counts, and Mrs. Gable will appreciate the fresh look.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I haven't heard much about the repair drive. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, have you heard what exactly is wrong with the car? We need specifics before we can plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Actually, I thought the repair drive was for Mrs. Gable's fence this Saturday — Gus mentioned he's bringing tools for that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at the community center, eh? Good, I can plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's from 9 to 3—try to get there early if you can!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks for the heads-up, Vik. I'll be there right at 9 with my toaster in hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'll be there Saturday morning to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great, Sam! I'm planning to be there too — I've got some old tools I'm bringing to donate.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's awesome, Tess! The more tools the better — let's make this drive a success.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's what I keep saying — without a clear schedule and a plan B, we're just crossing our fingers and hoping for the best.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're also questioning it, then? Good, I thought I was the only one getting sketched out by this whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly, I'm glad we're on the same page. We need more than just hope—we need a real plan, or I'm not comfortable pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I'm late — did I miss much about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the basics: Saturday at the community center, bring broken stuff to fix. I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I'm in too — got a toaster and a laptop that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Bo, are you free to help out with the repair drive on Saturday the 14th? Noah’s checking his calendar too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Saturday the 14th? I thought it was just Saturday, but I'll check my schedule. Maybe I can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, let me know what you find. If that day doesn't work, we can look at another Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Dane, I heard about the repair drive. Saturday at the community center, right? Ira's picking up some tools for me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, glad to hear you're on board too. I'm bringing my old laptop I've been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good. A laptop, huh? Hope they've got someone who knows their way around those things. I'm just bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh good, maybe I'll swing by the school to see if they're there yet. Did you need anything for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No, I'm all set—I think I'll just show up Saturday if I can make it. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Alright, sounds good—I'll head over now to check, and hopefully I'll catch you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll be there at 9 with my tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Leo. I'll have my spare wrenches ready if anyone forgets theirs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, we'll have plenty of backup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'll be there Saturday morning ready to help haul whatever's needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Sam, that's wonderful—thank you! I'll put you down for the morning crew.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll see you Saturday morning then!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Uli, can you tell me more about what this repair drive is exactly? I want to make sure we have all the details right before we proceed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community thing to fix up the playground. Rosa's organizing it for next Saturday. I said I'd try to come, but I'm not sure how long I can stay.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds like a great idea. Do you know if Rosa has a list of what tools we'll need? I want to make sure we're prepared.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I just saw Tess and she mentioned the repair drive too—word's getting around fast!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good to hear! I've already started sorting through my shed for usable parts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's really helpful, Cleo! With your shed supplies and Tess's enthusiasm, this drive is shaping up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you're worried about running out of daylight? How many hours do you think we'll need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Probably at least a full day, maybe more if we uncover hidden damage. That's why I'm asking about a backup plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What kind of hidden damage are you expecting? I need to know what we're dealing with.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I just talked to Eli about the repair drive — I'm grabbing some screwdrivers and tape for him later. You heard anything else about it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I haven't seen any official notice about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, Eli seemed pretty set on it — maybe it's just a word-of-mouth thing. I'll still grab those tools, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, just spreading the word—the repair drive is Saturday from 9 to 3, and I've been telling everyone to come early with whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks for spreading the word! I still need to check in with the Smiths and the Lees to make sure they're on board—want to help me reach out to them?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I'd love to help! I'll remind them it's Saturday from 9 to 3 and to come early if they can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? That sounds familiar—is that the thing where we gather old toasters and wobbly chairs?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's the one! It's this Saturday at the community center, and they'll fix up anything for free. I'm even bringing some old tools to donate and helping out in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great, so it's this Saturday? I might have a wonky lamp I've been meaning to bring, if I can find it by then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey, Rey! I was just thinking about the repair drive—Noah mentioned he might be busy on the 14th. Have you got any other dates in mind?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I'm still catching up on the details. What dates were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Well, I was leaning toward Saturday the 14th, but Noah's not sure if he's free. How about Sunday the 15th or maybe the following weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, I didn’t see anyone get out—it just pulled around the corner and parked near the old oak tree.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's odd—well, I'm more focused on the repair drive, I heard we're collecting tools and fabric scraps for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I heard that too—I've got some spare canvas I was planning to drop off at the community center.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
